B_fourPaths.componentToComponent: tests/events-paths.test.ts "component -> component": trusted component publishes component.observation.reported; a zero-model handler consumes the durable delivery once; duplicate publish yields no second effect.
B_fourPaths.componentToAgent: tests/events-paths.test.ts "component -> agent background/continuation": durable zero-model background marker; continuation only after trusted gate; context receipt confirmed separately; fan-out and BackgroundPump-shaped scan also covered.
B_fourPaths.agentToComponent: tests/events-paths.test.ts "agent -> component": a real mounted worker tool report (agent.observation.reported) is published with host actor and consumed by a zero-model component handler.
B_fourPaths.agentToAgent: tests/events-paths.test.ts "agent -> agent": a real mounted worker tool report (worker.result.reported) reaches a bound Agent target only after Goal/authorization/instance/budget gate; native context receipt confirmed; worker cannot publish task.succeeded.
B_fourPaths.zeroModelBoundaries: component handler, background marker and denied continuation never call the model (wake counters are 0); only an allowed continuation appends one synthetic native context message.
B_fourPaths.ackVsContextLoaded: batch receipts expose outcome=acked separately from dispatched/contextReceipt; tests assert background-only acked decisions have no context receipt, and lost-ack retries keep one native append.

C_lifecycle.onceAndDeadline: tests/events-lifecycle.test.ts one-shot/expiry: only first match delivered; expired subscription creates no dispatch eligibility; pause cancels pending, resume does not restore the paused-epoch delivery.
C_lifecycle.ownerScopeRevisionActivation: subscription owner/revision/ruleRevision/activationGeneration covered by existing events.test.ts plus new stale/retire tests; unregistered/retired Agent binding never dispatches.
C_lifecycle.restartAndAtLeastOnce: effect committed before lost ack survives a real store close/reopen with a new store handle; retried delivery id keeps one business effect; lost continuation ack retries without a second native append.
C_lifecycle.subscriptionWatermark: from_now never backfills; bounded replay declares replayedCount/replayTruncated; post-watermark events match once per subscription.
C_lifecycle.slowBadConsumerIsolation: handler timeout bounds a slow consumer; a healthy subscription still acks; poison handler failure stays on its own delivery and does not leak.
